mechanism: Both drugs can cause gastrointestinal toxicity and hemolysis; primaquine increases risk of hemolytic anemia in G6PD-deficient patients while colchicine may worsen GI symptoms and increase toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis, GI distress, and myopathy; ensure G6PD screening before primaquine use and avoid combination if possible; dose adjustment may be needed for colchicine in renal impairment.
